_notes: Sound effects for the hazard perception tests, generated with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API. Every sound the player plays (hazard, correct, wrong, fanfare, sad) and every sound named in a test's clip events needs an entry. duration is seconds (0.5 to 22). promptInfluence is 0 to 1; higher follows the prompt more literally. Changing a prompt or duration re-records that sound on the next `npm run audio:generate`.

hazard.prompt: Two short urgent electronic alert beeps, like a quiz show warning, clean, no music

correct.prompt: Bright game show correct-answer chime, two rising bell notes, cheerful, short

wrong.prompt: Short low game show wrong-answer buzzer, comedic, single blunt buzz

clink.prompt: Pint glass set down on a wooden pub bar with a light glass clink, close up, single hit

pour.prompt: Beer pouring from a pub tap into a pint glass, foamy, steady stream, close up

till.prompt: Old mechanical cash register ding and drawer sliding open in a pub, single

fanfare.prompt: Short triumphant brass band fanfare, proud and slightly pompous, British village band

sad.prompt: Sad trombone wah wah wah wah, comedic failure, four descending notes

door.prompt: Pub front door opening with a small brass shop bell jingling above it, single, short

whoosh.prompt: Quick soft whoosh of someone spinning round on the spot, subtle cartoon camera pan, short

surge.prompt: Guinness stout pouring from a nitro tap into a pint glass, creamy rushing surge, close up

fizz.prompt: Gentle fizzing of lager bubbles and foam settling in a pint glass, close up, quiet

beep.prompt: Contactless card payment terminal approved, two short electronic beeps, clean
